notes:
Topline: building a unified clinical search layer for inpatient EHR notes + imaging reports. Heavy PHI footprint — primary requirement is airtight audit logging and per-request identity mapping. Interested in Redwood for embeddings + reranking (RAG) to surface most relevant passages and then run model reranker for clinical prioritization.

Key constraints: must support VPC/private control plane or on-prem isolated serving; persistent KV-caching options to keep token costs down for common queries; per-request KMS-wrapped keys; retention controls (30/90/365 day policies).

From calls: "We cannot send raw PHI to third-party-hosted endpoints without explicit contract & audit controls" (security lead). Want explicit throughput numbers: 95th percentile p99 latency target 120-200ms for single-pass embeddings+rerank pipeline at 100 qps; cost per query target <$0.08 (including embed + rerank).

Preference: LLM model family that supports quantized deployment on A100/Trn hardware; fallback routing to cheaper distill models during peak. Interested in Optimize recommendations for batch sizes and quantization profiles.

CRM shorthand: POC (embeds+rerank) running against 50M doc index; currently using Faiss on-prem for vector store — evaluating Redwood to offload reranker inference and manage rollout. SE asked for sample token-cost breakdown and latency bench run. Legal loop started (NDA signed), security questionnaire delivered.

use_case_summary: Primary: clinical document retrieval for clinicians (fast, precise). Secondary: coding assistance and discharge summary generation. Must prioritize recall for safety-critical queries and then rerank for clinical relevance. Looking to minimize per-query unit-cost while maintaining p95 latency <200ms for interactive use.
technical_requirements_summary: Scale: target index sizes 30M-100M passages. Latency: interactive p95 <= 200ms for embed+rerank pipeline at baseline 50 qps; cost target <$0.08/query. Security: VPC/private control plane, per-request audit logs with user identity mapping, KMS/HSM integration, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence, data residency in US-only regions. Ops: ability to pin model versions, canary rollout, automatic fallback to smaller model family under load.
poc_scope: Embeddings generation + vector store connector (Faiss -> Redwood overlay), lightweight reranker model deployment (quantized) to rescore top-50 candidates. Metrics: recall@10, mean reciprocal rank, p95 latency, cost-per-query. Deliverables: perf runbook, cost model, security integration checklist.
sales_play_notes: Lead AE (Ava) to push Dedicated/private pricing. Emphasize Optimize savings: batching, prefix caching for common templates; show prior benchmark: 35% token cost reduction via prefix caching + quantization. Coordinate demo with SE Daniel and Security SME Priya.
